name: Split Squat Front Foot Elevated (Smith Machine)
instructions: Place a low plate under your front foot inside a Smith machine and rest the bar on your upper back.
Step the back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive up through the front foot.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength and balance are what keep you steady on uneven ground and stairs. Lunge work trains the stability that prevents the falls that change lives.
overview: A split squat with the front foot elevated on a Smith machine that increases range for the quads and glutes.
